summary.text: Kevin Jensen is a Republican state senator from South Dakota Senate District 16 who assumed office in January 2025 after serving in the state House from 2017 to 2025, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
An inventor and small business owner, he chairs the Senate Health and Human Services Committee.

paragraphs.text: Kevin Jensen earned a graduate degree from the Sioux Falls Seminary in 2020, and his career experience includes working as an inventor and small business owner.
Jensen represented South Dakota House of Representatives District 16 from 2017 to 2025 and chaired the House Health and Human Services Committee in the 2019-2020 through 2023-2024 sessions.

He assumed office in the State Senate on January 14, 2025, and in the 2025-2026 session chairs the Senate Health and Human Services Committee, serves as vice chair of the Senate Agriculture and Natural Resources Committee, and is assigned to the Senate State Affairs Committee.
